about: You’ve finished the work. Getting the invoice out should be the easy part. Invoice Creator turns the details of a job into a clear, professional invoice or estimate, right from your phone.

Set up your business once, save your clients, and add the work you’ve done. Create and edit offline, then share a PDF through the app you choose. Your business details and documents stay on your device.
Built for people who bill by the job: contractors, electricians, plumbers, cleaners, photographers and independent freelancers. A focused tool for documents and follow-up.

features.title: From estimate to invoice
features.text: Quote the job, then convert the estimate to an invoice when it’s approved. Duplicate a document for repeat work.

features.title: A PDF with your name on it
features.text: Add your business details and logo. Share a professional PDF by email, messaging or storage through your phone’s share sheet.

features.title: Less typing, next time
features.text: Save client details and set your usual currency, tax rate and payment terms. Running totals update as you edit.

features.title: Keep track of the follow-up
features.text: Mark invoices sent or paid yourself, see what you’re owed, and spot overdue invoices at a glance.

release.label: First release · in testing
release.text: Invoices and estimates, saved clients, PDF sharing, and a clear view of what you’re owed. Works offline, with no account or sign-up.

safety_intro: Your documents stay on your device. Some technical, usage and subscription data leaves the app, as explained below.

safety.title: Business data stays local
safety.text: Client details, invoices, estimates and your logo are stored on your phone. PDFs are shared only when you choose a destination.

safety.title: Automatic analytics in configured builds
safety.text: Native builds with a bundled analytics key collect usage events, device and session identifiers, approximate location, and masked screen recordings. There is no analytics setting. Web and key-free builds send no PostHog data.

safety.title: Technical data for app updates
safety.text: Native release builds contact Expo for updates, independently of analytics. Requests include an installation identifier and app metadata; Expo also sees the connection’s IP address.

safety.title: Subscriptions through Apple or Google
safety.text: Yearly and monthly plans are bought and cancelled in the App Store or Google Play, which handle payment. RevenueCat checks and restores subscriptions using a random app user ID and the store’s purchase records. KLM Labs never sees card details.

safety.title: No ads or cross-app tracking
safety.text: No advertising, data sales or tracking across other apps. Contact KLM Labs to ask about data or request deletion.
